reasoning_content:
Now generate .env. Need to feed inputs to create_secrets.sh non-interactively. Let me construct the answers.

Prompts order:
1. Login email default spark@example.com (prompt_default - read from stdin)
2. Login password (prompt_secret, requires non-empty)
3. First name default Spark
4. Last name default User

Then LiteLLM base URL (required), master key (secret required), text model (required), embedding model (required), visual model (required)

Then Docling protocol default https, host (required), port default 443, ocr engine default easyocr, token url optional, client id optional, client secret optional secret.

I'll pipe answers. Let me write all lines.

email: spark@example.com (or just blank to accept default; blank works)
password: SparkLocal123!
first: Spark
last: User
LLM base URL: http://host.docker.internal:4000 (arbitrary)
master key: sk-local-key
text model: gpt-4o-mini
embedding model: text-embedding-3-small
visual model: gpt-4o-mini
docling protocol: http
docling host: localhost
docling port: 5001
ocr engine: rapidocr
token url: (blank)
client id: (blank)
client secret: (blank)

Note prompt_secret uses `read -r -s` which reads from stdin fine. Blank line for defaults.

Let me pipe with printf. Note the optional secret also reads. Let's do it.

Actually we should use the local Docling container to be closer to guide. But running it may take time/memory — it's ~ several GB. Let's consider. The guide says "You can point the setup at an existing Docling deployment, or run a local CPU container". For installation verification we mainly need the stack to come up. Docling isn't required for infra startup. I'll run the Docling container too if resources permit, but it's a big image. Let me focus first on getting the core stack up.

Let me create .env.

action.command:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && printf '%s\n' \
  'spark@example.com' \
  'SparkLocal123!' \
  'Spark' \
  'User' \
  'http://localhost:4000' \
  'sk-local-key' \
  'gpt-4o-mini' \
  'text-embedding-3-small' \
  'gpt-4o-mini' \
  'http' \
  'localhost' \
  '5001' \
  'rapidocr' \
  '' \
  '' \
  '' | uv run poe create-secrets 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[1]}"; echo "--- .env ---"; ls -la .env && cat .env
